headline: Executive order sets up a White House council to coordinate federal rebuilding work on the Gulf Coast.
what_it_does: This order creates a group called the Gulf Coast Recovery and Rebuilding Council. Based on its title, the council's job is to help plan and coordinate the federal government's work to recover and rebuild the Gulf Coast region. It was signed in late 2005, a few months after Hurricanes Katrina and Rita hit the area. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council and what powers it has are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They would take part in or work with a new council that coordinates federal Gulf Coast recovery efforts.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities in the Gulf Coast region
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected indirectly, since the council is meant to shape how federal rebuilding help is planned and delivered.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 1, 2005; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
